Use case: stylized-concept. Project asset: ONE new unframed native Heroes of Might and Magic III champion portrait, Nunu and Willump, two inseparable Freljord companions. Create a completely fresh composition, not a revision of a modern cartoon portrait. This is a serious 1999 prerendered fantasy-game portrait, like a tiny hand-lit sculpt photographed and retouched in oil, with physically solid angular facial planes, tactile wool and shaggy fur, restrained colors, dramatic warm upper-left face light and deep cool blue cast shadows. NO illustration outlines, no anime, no Pixar/Disney softness, no cute toy eyes, no smooth plastic, no painterly splash art, no applied pixel-art filter.
One shared bust composition for a 58x64 game portrait: Nunu is a cheerful but naturally proportioned human boy about ten, small realistic eyes and nose, weathered rust-red wool hood, freckles, fur collar, left foreground. His faithful companion Willump is a huge ancient furry yeti with a broad substantial blue-grey ape/goat-like muzzle, narrow deep-set kind blue eyes under a heavy sculpted brow, natural broad nose, curved ivory horns and small ivory tusks, thick off-white shaggy fur catching small ochre highlights; his head fills the right half and rises behind Nunu. Keep both entire faces and both horns well inside the central safe frame. Nunu's joy comes from a subtle real smile, not exaggerated cartoon mouth. Willump looks wise and kindly protective, never evil, with strong face anatomy and heavy age.
Background: distant dark basalt and snowy evergreens, a tiny amber camp-lantern accent separated from the faces, richer saturated background with clear dark edges behind pale fur. Head-and-shoulders only, no hands, no large action, no extra characters, no snowball, no writing, border, UI, watermark. Front/three-quarter view, compact readable silhouettes, two contrasting face sizes. Every major plane must remain readable when uniformly reduced to 58x64 and 48x32. Medium close portrait canvas approximately 928x1024. Subject and rendering must belong next to the ORIGINAL Heroes III Knight and Cleric portraits, not contemporary League splash art. Independent artwork; do not copy any existing portrait pixels.
